logline: Meeting Father Thomas in an abandoned wing of the manor before dawn, Catherine orchestrates a calculated conspiracy to stall the council hearing and extract inside intelligence, sealing their treasonous alliance with intimate assurance.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Catherine sending Agnes to fetch Father Thomas under cover of darkness; now in Episode 49, Father Thomas slips into the secluded wing for their covert rendezvous.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Wide tracking shot down a dark, derelict hallway lined with dust-sheet draped furniture and peeling wallpaper. At the far end, a door creaks open, revealing a cloaked figure stepping in.

segments.label: SOUND FX
segments.text: Hinges creaking softly followed by the muffled thud of a heavy wooden door clicking shut.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Father Thomas, clad in a hooded dark mantle over priestly black robes, secures the door behind him and steps into the shadows of the abandoned corridor.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Catherine, draped in a dark hooded cloak over a lavish crimson bodice, holding a brass candlestick aloft.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Quietly Chiding)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You took your time.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot past Father Thomas's cloaked back looking toward Catherine illuminated in warm candlelight.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Father Thomas under his black hood, his stern face framed by the clerical collar and silver crucifix resting on his chest.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Low, Measured)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: Agnes is thorough. She made me wait for a groom to finish his rounds before she'd let me past the stables.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up profile of Catherine, turning with a slight, knowing smirk.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Pleased, Cold)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Good. That's what I pay her for.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as Catherine steps forward and sets the heavy candleholder onto a small round table draped in grey cloth between them.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine sets down the brass candleholder, the flame flickering across their faces.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Father Thomas's face, the candlelight dancing in his calculating eyes.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Grave)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: No shadows tonight, Catherine. Just us and an empty wing.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, her blonde ringlets peeking from beneath her velvet hood as she smiles faintly.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Unfazed)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Father Thomas, glancing down momentarily before fixing his piercing gaze back on her.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Dry, Cynical)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine's face hardening into a stern, focused expression.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Assertive, Warning)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Father Thomas listening impassively.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium wide two-shot across the candlelit table, Catherine leaning slightly forward.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Scheming)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up on Father Thomas as he turns his head slightly, scanning the dusty shadowed recesses of the abandoned room.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Reflective, Brooding)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, her lips curling into an amused, knowing smile.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Amused)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: You always did have a taste for symbolism.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot of Father Thomas, a subtle smirk breaking through his austere demeanor.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Intimate, Candid)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, her expression turning razor-sharp and commanding.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Strict, Urgent)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Side profile close-up on Father Thomas, his brow furrowing with impatient resolve.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Direct)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine raising one hand slightly, emphasizing her terms.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Calculating, Determined)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Frontal close-up of Catherine raising two fingers in the candlelight, her eyes burning with ruthless intent.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Fierce, Uncompromising)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Father Thomas absorbing the audacity of her demand.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Skeptical)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up low angle on Catherine, tilting her chin up in defiant pride.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Haughty, Imperious)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Bitterly Resolute)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Seductive, Reassuring)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Stern, Stark)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Catherine, her lips parting into an alluring, promising smile.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Tempting)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: Careful men who help me also get remembered.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Split focus close-up between Father Thomas's intense gaze and Catherine leaning in close, whispering with lethal conviction.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispering, Promising)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Medium two-shot as Father Thomas extends his open right hand between them.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Father Thomas slowly raises his right hand, palm turned upward in invitation and pact.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Low, Resigned)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up on Father Thomas looking down into her eyes.

segments.label: FATHER THOMAS (Softly)
segments.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
segments.text: Then we understand each other.

segments.label: ACTION
segments.text: Catherine reaches out and places her slender hand firmly into Father Thomas's open palm.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Close-up of Catherine gazing up at him, her eyes glistening in the candlelight.

segments.label: CATHERINE (Intimate)
segments.speaker: CATHERINE
segments.text: We always have.

segments.label: CAMERA
segments.text: Extreme close-up as Father Thomas gently raises his other hand and cups Catherine's cheek tenderly, her hand resting against his chest as she leans into his touch before cutting to black.
